lookback_source.quote: Review the resident’s medical record for the 7-day look-back period.

lookback_notes: The manual states a 7-day look-back period for E0100; coding is based on behaviors observed and/or thoughts expressed "in the last 7 days." The pages do not state how the 7 days are counted relative to the ARD.

coding_levels.label: A. Hallucinations
coding_levels.definition: Check E0100A if hallucinations were present in the last 7 days. A hallucination is the perception of the presence of something that is not actually there. It may be auditory or visual or involve smells, tastes or touch.

source.quote: Check E0100A, hallucinations: if hallucinations were present in the last 7 days. A hallucination is the perception of the presence of something that is not actually there. It may be auditory or visual or involve smells, tastes or touch.

coding_levels.label: Hallucinations not present
coding_levels.definition: E0100Z, none of the above, is checked if no hallucinations or delusions were present in the last 7 days.

source.quote: Check E0100Z, none of the above: if no hallucinations or delusions were present in the last 7 days.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code based on behaviors observed and/or thoughts expressed in the last 7 days rather than the presence of a medical diagnosis; check all that apply.

source.quote: Code based on behaviors observed and/or thoughts expressed in the last 7 days rather than the presence of a medical diagnosis. Check all that apply.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Check E0100A (hallucinations) if hallucinations were present in the last 7 days.

source.quote: Check E0100A, hallucinations: if hallucinations were present in the last 7 days.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Resident intent is not taken into account when coding items in Section E; code the resident's actions, not the intent of their behavior.

source.quote: Resident intent should not be taken into account when coding for items in this section.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A report that reflects misinterpretation of a real external sound/stimulus is not coded as a hallucination (E0100Z checked instead).

source.quote: Rationale: They misinterpreted a real sound in the external environment.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Reported auditory and visual sensations occurring in the absence of any external stimulus are coded as a hallucination (E0100A checked).

source.quote: Rationale: The resident reports auditory and visual sensations that occur in the absence of any external stimulus. Therefore, this is a hallucination.

federal.criterion: Review of the resident's medical record for the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Review the resident’s medical record for the 7-day look-back period.

federal.criterion: Interview staff members and others who have had the opportunity to observe the resident in a variety of situations during the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Interview staff members and others who have had the opportunity to observe the resident in a variety of situations during the 7-day look-back period.

federal.criterion: Observation of the resident during conversations and structured interviews in other assessment sections, listening for statements indicating an experience of hallucinations.

source.quote: Observe the resident during conversations and the structured interviews in other assessment sections and listen for statements indicating an experience of hallucinations, or the expression of false beliefs (delusions).

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages do not tie E0100A to any payment or case-mix classification.
